solutions.title: Bit loop
solutions.strategy: Read the low bit 32 times, append it to the result, and shift the input right.

timeComplexity.explanation: The loop has one iteration per bit position.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the input copy, result, and loop index are stored.

solutions.title: Mask swaps
solutions.strategy: Swap bit groups of size 16, 8, 4, 2, and 1 using fixed masks.

timeComplexity.explanation: A fixed number of bit-mask operations is executed.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the transformed integer is stored.
